environment.description: Same provider binary deployed in Terraform Cloud managed execution environment. Feature flag evaluation is handled by LaunchDarkly Go SDK v6 initialized with server-side SDK key for project 'infra-providers'. The flag 'use-legacy-key-validation' is configured with a kill switch targeting rule: when context attribute 'terraform-execution-env' equals 'tfc-managed', flag evaluates to false with 0% rollout on true variant. The SDK is initialized in streaming mode with a 2-second initialization timeout and uses the default in-memory store. Flag default (fallback on SDK failure) is set to false in the provider code's LDClient.BoolVariation call. Additionally, the Terraform Cloud workspace has a Sentinel policy 'restrict-legacy-crypto' that would fail plan if the provider emitted a legacy_validation_used attribute, though this is a secondary guardrail.

config.network: Terraform Cloud egress through NAT gateway, 5-15ms jitter to key endpoint
